_doc: Festival demand spikes. multiplier(t) = 1 + uplift * shape(t): shape ramps linearly from 0 at -pre_days to 1 at -plateau_days, holds 1 through the festival day, and decays linearly to 0 by +post_days. Families not listed get no uplift. Diwali (Lakshmi Puja) dates per the Hindu lunisolar calendar.
